name: CPU Mesh Voxelization
aliases: AABB voxel traversal with plane/edge tests
definition: A CPU-based algorithm that converts a triangle mesh into a 3D grid of voxels by iterating over the bounding box of each triangle and testing each voxel center against the triangle's plane and edge constraints.
summary: CPU Mesh Voxelization converts triangle meshes to voxel grids using exact geometric tests, differing from rasterization-based methods by outputting binary occupancy grids rather than cube meshes.
